title: Delhi Police Drafts New Rules For Ramlila Ground Protests, Sets 50,000-Person Cap

ai.summary: Delhi Police proposed a 50,000-person cap for protests at Ramlila Ground, restricting demonstrations to 10 am–5 pm with mandatory MCD clearance and police permission.

facts.claim: Delhi Police's draft SOP proposes a maximum capacity of 50,000 people at Ramlila Ground
facts.quote: - Delhi Police's draft SOP proposes a maximum capacity of 50,000 people at Ramlila Ground.

facts.claim: Protests and demonstrations would be restricted to 10 am–5 pm, with marches and processions prohibited
facts.quote: - Protests and demonstrations would be restricted to 10 am–5 pm, with marches and processions prohibited.

facts.claim: Organisers would need an MCD Venue Availability Certificate and separate police permission before holding events
facts.quote: Organisers will first have to obtain a ‘Venue Availability Certificate’ from the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD), which owns Ramlila Ground, before applying for police permission through the designated Arrangement Cell of the Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP), Central District.

ai.background_note: Delhi Police de-notified Jantar Mantar as a protest site in October, designating Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and CBD Ground as alternative locations for protests.
